metadata.technology_specification: Discrete graphics processing unit (GPU) card with GDDR6 memory
metadata.technology_reasoning: Discrete GPUs with dedicated GDDR6 memory represent the industry-standard graphics solution for PCs and workstations as of 2024, dominating the market with their superior performance for gaming, professional visualization, and compute tasks compared to integrated graphics.

components.reasoning: The core functional component responsible for parallel processing and rendering, always present as a separate semiconductor die on the GPU card.
High-speed dedicated memory modules providing bandwidth for the GPU, procured separately and standard in discrete GPUs today.
The substrate that hosts the GPU die, memory chips, power delivery circuits, and interfaces, essential for the GPU card assembly.

components.component: VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power Delivery Components
components.reasoning: Ensures stable and efficient power supply to the GPU and memory chips, typically a distinct assembly or set of components on the PCB.
Thermal management assembly critical for maintaining performance and reliability, usually a separate module mounted to the GPU card.
The electrical and physical interface for connecting the GPU card to the motherboard, standard and separately manufactured.
Supports mechanical stability and cooling, common in most mid-to-high-end GPU cards though sometimes integrated or omitted in budget models.

GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).name: Silicon
GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor base material of the GPU die, absolutely essential for all integrated circuits including GPUs.

GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).name: Copper
GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).reasoning: Copper is extensively used in the interconnects and wiring within the GPU chip for electrical conduction; it is the industry standard with no practical substitute at scale.

GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).name: Aluminum
GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).reasoning: Aluminum may be used in some interconnect layers and packaging; widely used but copper largely dominates the interconnect material.

GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).name: Tungsten
GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).reasoning: Tungsten is often used as vias and contact plugs in semiconductor fabrication; typical but alternatives exist such as copper connections.

GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).name: Nickel
GPU Chip (Graphics Processor Die).reasoning: Nickel may be used as a barrier metal in contacts and plating, but alternatives like cobalt or other materials may be used, so moderately confident.

GDDR6 Memory Modules.name: Silicon
GDDR6 Memory Modules.reasoning: Silicon is the semiconductor base material of memory chips, essential for GDDR6 operation.

GDDR6 Memory Modules.name: Copper
GDDR6 Memory Modules.reasoning: Copper is used for wiring and interconnects in memory chips and modules; standard industry material.

GDDR6 Memory Modules.name: Aluminum
GDDR6 Memory Modules.reasoning: Aluminum is used in some wiring layers and packaging; common but copper is generally preferred.

GDDR6 Memory Modules.name: Ceramic
GDDR6 Memory Modules.reasoning: Ceramic materials are often used in the packaging substrate of memory modules for electrical insulation and thermal performance, alternatives exist (like organic substrates).

GDDR6 Memory Modules.name: Tin
GDDR6 Memory Modules.reasoning: Tin is typically used for soldering memory chips to the PCB; alternatives exist but tin-lead free solders dominate now.

PCB (Printed Circuit Board).name: Copper
PCB (Printed Circuit Board).reasoning: Copper is the primary conductor material in PCB traces and planes, absolutely essential for electrical connections.

PCB (Printed Circuit Board).name: Glass
PCB (Printed Circuit Board).reasoning: Glass fibers make up the fiberglass substrate reinforcement in PCBs providing mechanical strength and electrical insulation, industry standard.

PCB (Printed Circuit Board).name: Epoxy resins
PCB (Printed Circuit Board).reasoning: Epoxy resins are the major polymeric matrix for PCB substrates, essential for structural integrity and insulation.

PCB (Printed Circuit Board).name: Copper oxide
PCB (Printed Circuit Board).reasoning: Copper oxide may form as surface treatment or passivation in manufacturing but not essential, low to moderate confidence.

VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.name: Copper
VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.reasoning: Copper is essential for power delivery wiring and coils due to high conductivity.

VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.name: Aluminum
VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.reasoning: Aluminum may be used in heat sinks and some components, widely used for thermal management.

VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.name: Iron
VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.reasoning: Iron is used in magnetic cores of inductors and transformers in VRMs, common material though ferrite ceramics also used.

VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.name: Ceramic
VRM (Voltage Regulator Module) / Power D.reasoning: Ceramics are used for capacitors and insulating components in VRMs; standard materials used for electrical isolation.

Cooling Solution (Heatsink and Fan Assem.name: Aluminum
Cooling Solution (Heatsink and Fan Assem.reasoning: Aluminum is the predominant material for heatsink fins and base due to its excellent thermal conductivity and light weight.

Cooling Solution (Heatsink and Fan Assem.name: Copper
Cooling Solution (Heatsink and Fan Assem.reasoning: Copper is often used in base plates or heat pipes for better thermal conductivity, but higher cost means aluminum often substitutes copper.

Interface Connector (PCIe Edge Connector.name: Copper
Interface Connector (PCIe Edge Connector.reasoning: Copper is the standard conductive material for PCIe edge connector contacts, absolutely essential for electrical connectivity.

Interface Connector (PCIe Edge Connector.name: Gold
Interface Connector (PCIe Edge Connector.reasoning: Gold is commonly used as a surface plating for corrosion resistance and reliable contacts in connectors, industry standard.

Interface Connector (PCIe Edge Connector.name: Fiberglass
Interface Connector (PCIe Edge Connector.reasoning: Fiberglass is typically used as part of the PCB-like substrate material of the connector, providing mechanical strength and insulation.

Backplate / Structural Frame.name: Aluminum
Backplate / Structural Frame.reasoning: Aluminum is widely used for backplates and frames due to its light weight, structural strength, and corrosion resistance.

Backplate / Structural Frame.name: Steel Ingots
Backplate / Structural Frame.reasoning: Steel (from steel ingots) may be used for stronger, heavier structural frames especially in premium models; common but less frequent than aluminum.
